basic_details.short_information: The Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag (HP JSV) has officially announced the Para Pump Operator, Para Fitter & Para Multipurpose Worker Recruitment 2026 with 40 openings. The detailed notification was published on the official website of HP JSV. Candidates who meet the age criteria of 18 to 45 years and hold Matriculation (10th) with ITI Certificate in relevant trade or Middle pass and above qualification can now submit their offline applications on or before 29 August 2026. Direct links to download the notification and apply offline are shared below.

age_limit.details: All Posts: Minimum 18 years, Maximum 45 years.

qualification.education_qualification: Matriculation (10th) with ITI Certificate in relevant trade, Middle pass or above
qualification.details: Para Pump Operator: Matriculation (10th) with ITI Certificate in the trade of Electrician/Wireman/Diesel Mechanic/Pump Mechanic/Mechanic (Motor Vehicle)/Pump operation-cum-Mechanic/Pump Operation & Maintenance from a recognized ITI or Matriculation (10th) with certificate under Skill Development Scheme of the Government Para Fitter: Matriculation (10th) with ITI Certificate in the trade of Fitter/Plumber from a recognized ITI/Institute or Matriculation (10th) with certificate under Skill Development Scheme of the Government Multipurpose Workers: Middle pass or above from School duly recognized by the State Government

salary_details.details: Para Pump Operator: 7100/- P.M. Para Fitter: 7100/- P.M. Multipurpose Workers: 6000/- P.M.

selection_process: Merit based on educational qualification marks Experience weightage Skill Test Physical Test
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for HP JSV Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://jsv.hp.nic.in/
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 29-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for HP JSV Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://jsv.hp.nic.in/ Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 29-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag (HP JSV). It is a government department responsible for water resources in the state.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in HP JSV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Para Pump Operator, Para Fitter, and Para Multipurpose Worker. These roles are essential for the functioning of the department's operations.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are a total of 40 vacancies announced for various posts under the HP JSV Recruitment 2026. This includes positions for operators, fitters, and multipurpose workers.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates interested in applying for these positions must submit their applications through offline mode. They need to download, fill, and send the application form to the specified address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for HP JSV posts?
faq.answer: The last date for candidates to submit their completed application forms for the HP JSV recruitment is 29 August 2026. Applicants should ensure timely submission.

faq.question: Q6. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification varies by post. For some, it's Matriculation (10th) with an ITI Certificate, while for Multipurpose Workers, it's Middle pass or above from a recognized school.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for HP JSV recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for these posts must be between 18 and 45 years of age. The age will be calculated as on the last date of application submission.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Para Pump Operator?
faq.answer: The Para Pump Operator position offers a salary of Rs. 7100/- per month. Salaries for other posts like Para Fitter and Multipurpose Workers vary slightly.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category, including General/OBC and SC/ST candidates, for the HP JSV Recruitment 2026. This makes it accessible to all eligible applicants.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for HP JSV?
faq.answer: The official website for Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag, where candidates can find more details and download the application form, is www.hpiph.org. It's the primary source for official updates.
